contents: the complete #76 study run directory: every start file (both arms, every M: executed actions, observed states, predicted misses, failures, audit checks, model one-step errors; each arm's recovery and diagnostic advantage; the open-loop cells), timing, identity.json, record.json, run and audit logs, and the fresh-process audit
